service.description: The HVAC demo's history, dated back from the load so that the Devices app's Observability shows the last days: a reading every 15 minutes over the last 7 days of the PLC's room temperature and humidity, duct temperature and humidity (ParameterLog, a day and night cycle around their setpoints with a little noise), the fan speed and air flow references (higher in occupied hours), the humidity control switched on and off (a text log), and DeviceLog events of the PLC, the pumps, the valves and the fan (starts, stops, openings, alarms). Each series is written only when its parameter has no log yet, and the events only when the PLC has none, so a second load adds nothing; refresh true first deletes the demo's logs and events and writes them again from now, for a demo grown old.
